description: This is a unit test class for the DittoDuration class, containing tests for immutability, parsing durations from strings, validation checks, and string representations.

classes.name: DittoDurationTest
classes.description: Test suite for the DittoDuration class, verifying its immutability, parsing logic, boundary conditions, and string conversion behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the DittoDuration class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceFromNullDuration
methods.description: Checks that passing null to the 'of' method throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceFromNegativeDuration
methods.description: Ensures that negative durations are rejected with an appropriate exception.

methods.name: getInstanceFromPositiveDuration
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a positive Duration and verifies correct behavior.

methods.name: getInstanceFromZeroDuration
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from zero seconds and verifies the duration.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromString
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a string representing seconds.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringSeconds
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a string with 's' suffix representing seconds.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringMinutes
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a string with 'm' suffix representing minutes.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringMilliseconds
methods.description: Creates a DittoDuration from a string with 'ms' suffix representing milliseconds.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringWithAndWithoutSecondsIsEqual
methods.description: Verifies that parsing a plain number and a number with 's' suffix yields the same Duration.

methods.name: createDittoDurationFromStringHoursFails
methods.description: Ensures that parsing durations with 'h' suffix throws NumberFormatException.

methods.name: tryToParseEmptyString
methods.description: Checks that parsing an empty string as duration throws NumberFormatException.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method returns expected string representations for different durations.

methods.name: isZeroReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that durations with zero and non-zero values correctly report their 'isZero' status.

methods.name: parseDurationWithPositivePrefix
methods.description: Verifies parsing of durations with a leading '+' sign.

methods.name: tryToParseDurationWithNegativeAmountAndSuffix
methods.description: Ensures that negative durations with 's' suffix are rejected.

methods.name: tryToParseDurationWithNegativeAmountWithoutSuffix
methods.description: Ensures that negative durations without suffix are rejected.
